claim: In TransmuterModule.bulkUpsertMaster, when isFullSync is true, the generated INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE statement omits the WHERE COALESCE(EXCLUDED._source_ts, 0) >= COALESCE(master._source_ts, 0) OCC condition.
evidence:
REF: /Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/data-hub/centralized-data-service/internal/service/master/transmuter.go:1636-1650
	if isFullSync {
		sqlText = fmt.Sprintf(`INSERT INTO %s (%s) VALUES %s
			ON CONFLICT (%s) DO UPDATE SET %s
			RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted`,
			qt, strings.Join(cols, ", "), strings.Join(placeholders, ", "),
			conflictIdent, strings.Join(sets, ", "))
	} else {
		const clockSkewToleranceMs = 2000
		sqlText = fmt.Sprintf(`INSERT INTO %s (%s) VALUES %s
			ON CONFLICT (%s) DO UPDATE SET %s
			WHERE COALESCE(EXCLUDED._source_ts, 0) >= COALESCE(%s._source_ts, 0) - %d
			RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted`,
			qt, strings.Join(cols, ", "), strings.Join(placeholders, ", "),
			conflictIdent, strings.Join(sets, ", "), qt, clockSkewToleranceMs)
	}
flow: bulkUpsertMaster builds the PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE statement with or without OCC based on isFullSync.
